title: worker-eval arm
description: One replayable configuration of the autopilot worker. run.py checks required keys, types and the enum/range constraints below (no jsonschema dependency).

name.description: Must equal the file name without .json.

model.description: pi model string provider/id. Only the garden provider (Bonsai via turnstile) is replayed; the id must be the virtual model registered in agent/models.bonsai-agent.json.

worker_description.description: Text naming the replayed model in the prompt's first line ('running as <this>. The project'). It replaces the case's worker_description_to exactly once.

max_output_tokens.description: maxTokens of the model registration (sent as max_tokens).

session_timeout_min.description: Wall-clock limit for one pi session; the process group is killed after it.

worker_memory.description: null = no memory tool or extension. 'mem0' = the evals/arms/<name>.json mem0 setup (not implemented by run.py yet; W3).

extensions.description: Repo-relative paths of extra .ts extension files copied into the agent dir's extensions/. submit_request.ts is how a session ends.

sources.description: Per setting: where its value comes from.
